book_metadata.title: Principles of Economics
book_metadata.author: N. Gregory Mankiw
book_metadata.source_file: N Gregory Mankiw - Principles Of Economics 2021 Cengage Learning - libgenli.pdf
book_metadata.artifact_purpose: Source-traceable, decision-oriented economics reasoning operating system for personal, creative, business, and policy reasoning.
book_metadata.personalization_boundary: The user's stability-first, debt-minimization philosophy appears only in operational-application layers and is not attributed to Mankiw.
book_metadata.copyright_handling: Records paraphrase and transform textbook foundations into reasoning metadata; the source text is not reproduced as a substitute for the textbook.

source_completeness.edition_identification: Ninth Edition; Cengage Learning; copyright 2021; ISBN 978-0-357-03831-4 visible in front matter.

unreadable_visuals: No pages were fully unreadable in the text layer during automated extraction. Some charts/tables are summarized from captions and visual inspection anchors rather than exhaustive manual redrawing.
The eBook front matter states that some third-party content may be suppressed because of electronic rights restrictions.
limitations: The figure and table counts are text-label occurrence counts from the extracted PDF text layer, not a manually deduplicated visual census.
Important graphs were curated into the graph registry for reasoning use; not every decorative or repeated graph is independently modeled.
End-of-chapter questions and applications are inventoried and used as signals for application areas but are not reproduced verbatim.
Current-data examples from the 2021 edition are not silently modernized; they are flagged where current verification is required.
Personal-finance, business, creative, and music recommendations are operational extensions designed for the user's reasoning library, not Mankiw-authored advice.
